text:
clare: heads-up: release 1.4.2 failed rubygems publish due to checksum mismatch on the tarball. local build checksum != artifact produced by CI. anyone seen this?

ben: that usually means the CI job is including extra files in the gem (like .DS_Store or vendor/). can you paste the `gem build` list?

clare: gist of gemspec files included: `lib/*`, `ext/**`, `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `sample-apps/*`. we intentionally included sample-apps to ease onboarding but maybe that bloats artifacts and causes platform-specific packaging diffs.

peggy: oof. sample-apps contains symlinks on mac that expand into absolute paths during tar creation. earlier we ignored them but a recent CI runner change followed symlinks. that will change checksums.

release-bot: :package: Release pipeline note: packaging step `build-gem` runs in alpine container. symlink handling differs between ubuntu/macOS. Recommend normalizing with `tar -h` or explicitly excluding symlinks.

clare: suggestion: remove sample-apps from gem artifact and publish them as a separate `redwood-examples` repo. keeps gem small and avoids cross-platform packaging surprises.

ben: thumbs up. also bump the changelog entry and ensure the gemspec's files list is explicit instead of using a wildcard. example: `s.files = Dir['lib/**/*'] + %w[README.md LICENSE CHANGELOG.md]`.

peggy: quick patch idea: in CI, after gem build, compute checksum and compare to locally generated checksum to detect environment drift earlier. while we fix, we can re-run the build in ubuntu runner to produce the canonical artifact.

ci-bot: :robot_face: CI failure from `build-gem` step: https://ci.example.com/6789/logs. Error snippet: `tar: symlink outside directory: sample-apps/bootstrap -> /Users/runner/`.

clare: thanks, CI link confirms symlink expansion. i'll open PR removing sample-apps from gemspec and moving a small README pointer to the `examples` folder in the repo root.

peggy: minimal support Q: windows users reported bundler failing with path length in sample-apps README (`./bin/run_demo`). should we add Windows instructions or just link to example Docker Compose?

ben: prefer linking to Docker for consistent dev env. adding platform-specific shell scripts is extra maintenance. Windows users can use WSL or Docker. add a short note in README: "If on Windows, prefer Docker or WSL; native scripts tested on macOS/Linux only."

clare: PR incoming. will include changelog entry, gemspec file list change, CI update to fail on symlinks, and a docs note about Docker for Windows.

release-bot: :sparkles: once PR merges, pipeline will re-run nightly publish job. please add `release:skip` label to the PR if you want to delay.

peggy: can we add a quick release checklist in devex docs to avoid surprises? items: local `gem build` checksum vs CI, explicit s.files, ruby versions in the matrix, and sample-apps exclusion.

clare: yes we'll add that. thanks all. merging PR after a quick review.

ben: one small follow-up: when we split examples into `redwood-examples`, ensure the gem README has a pinned commit link to examples so older releases still resolve to the matching sample code.

clare: good call. will include pinned link in changelog. merging in ~10m. :rocket:
